build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates two jars with balls on platforms to topple
create_jar_with_ball: create a jar with a ball inside using the _jar_with_ball helper function
add_static_bar: add a static bar obstacle to the scene using C.add with scale and angle
update_task_relationships: update the task to require two balls touching using C.update_task and SpatialRelationship
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to TWO_BALLS solution tier using C.set_meta
